reason.desc: Optional explanation for the access change.

user_ids.desc: IDs of frontline members in the authenticated organization. Valid users are queued; rejected IDs are returned in invalid\_users. _Minimum:_ `1` _Maximum:_ `1000`

desc: Pause access across the organization for up to 1,000 frontline members. Success means the request was queued, not that all updates have completed.

errors.failed_for_all_users: No valid users were found. Nothing was queued. invalid\_users lists the rejected IDs and reasons.
errors.failed_for_some_users: Valid users were queued, but some users were rejected. invalid\_users lists the rejected IDs and reasons. Correct and retry only those IDs.
errors.failed_job_enqueue: The access change could not be queued. Retry the request.
errors.feature_not_enabled: Frontline access management is not enabled for this organization.
errors.restricted_action: Only organization admins and owners can perform this action.
